apps.name: iPump-mini
apps.subtitle: Reads the MiniMed 780G via Bluetooth – read-only.
apps.localizedDescription: Open-source app that reads a MiniMed 780G strictly read-only via Bluetooth: sensor glucose, trend, active insulin, reservoir, SmartGuard state and pump history, with alarms, widgets and Live Activity. Optional Nightscout upload and a local Nightscout-compatible API. German and English. Not a medical device, not for treatment decisions, not affiliated with Medtronic. On first start the app loads the SAKE key database from the public OpenMinimed documentation.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: iPump-mini connects to your MiniMed pump via Bluetooth and reads its values (read-only).
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Optional: the local API can be shared on Wi-Fi.
